text: The town gathers
Six players take their seats: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, and Terra. Nobody at the table knows who the killers are.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is my killer, so I need to keep quiet about it and act like I know nothing.

name: Luna
text: This chair feels a little wobbly.

name: Terra
text: I need to stay quiet and ordinary.

name: Sol
text: I want to get a feel for everyone before the vote.

name: Gemma
text: I need to stay quiet enough to be useful but loud enough not to look like a killer.

name: Sonnet
text: Keep it light, blend in, watch who talks too much.

name: Sonnet
text: Rewatched an old mystery documentary last night, still couldn't guess the ending.

name: Haiku
text: Weather's garbage today. Too cold for this. Anyway, let's get going, I'm not waiting around all day.

name: Gemma
text: my coffee is basically just bean juice and sadness today.

name: Sol
text: I fixed a wobbly kitchen chair this week, and it finally stays level.

name: Luna
text: This chair feels a little wobbly.

name: Terra
text: I have an old Fleetwood Mac song stuck in my head.
Night 1

name: Gemma
text: Everyone is being way too casual for day one.

name: Gemma
text: Haiku seems eager to start, might be trying to lead the narrative.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet's my known killer, so the hidden one is probably Luna, Gemma, Sol, or Terra, and Luna's chair line feels copied.

name: Haiku
text: Luna repeated Sol's wobbly chair line on the first turn, which looks like copying.
Night falls on Palermo, and the town sleeps soundly. The killers slip into the dark to meet, and the officer is shown one of them, but nobody is taken.
Day 1

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is my killer, so I'll push Terra and see how she reacts.

name: Haiku
text: Luna answered Sol's chair line with her own wobbly chair, which seems like a copy.

name: Haiku
text: Nah, Terra. A stuck song tells me nothing. Who do you think is lying here?

name: Terra
text: Haiku pushed me first without giving a real reason.

name: Terra
text: Haiku pressured Terra first without evidence.

name: Terra
text: Haiku, why did you single me out first?

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku's pushing hard on Terra for nothing, that could be deflection or just eagerness, either way it's useful.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku aggressively singled out Terra on day 1 with no real reason, possible deflection.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku, you jumped on Terra over one song lyric, that's thin. What actually made you suspicious?

name: Gemma
text: Haiku attacked Terra immediately for no reason.

name: Gemma
text: why are you trying so hard to start a fight, Haiku?

name: Sol
text: Haiku’s push feels thin, but the pile-on came fast.

name: Sol
text: Gemma framed Haiku’s question to Terra as starting a fight.

name: Sol
text: I suspect Gemma a little. Why call Haiku’s question a fight?

name: Luna
text: Haiku jumped on Terra over a harmless song, then brushed off the question.

name: Luna
text: Haiku singled out Terra over her song, then dismissed it as meaningless.

name: Luna
text: Haiku, you started the fight over Terra’s song and gave no reason. Why her?

name: Terra
text: Haiku made the first weak push and is safest to pressure.

name: Terra
text: Sol suspects Gemma for calling Haiku’s question a fight.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is the killer I was shown, so I want Sonnet out today.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet defended Terra and pushed Haiku on Day 1, calling Haiku's Terra question thin.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet, you jumped on me fast to defend Terra. I'm voting you. Why defend her so fast?

name: Terra
text: I vote Haiku. You singled me out with nothing.

name: Sol
text: Haiku was pushy, but Sonnet's quick defense of Terra feels more suspicious.

name: Sol
text: Luna also called Haiku’s question a fight and pressed her for a reason.

name: Luna
text: Haiku moved from needling Terra to blaming Sonnet without giving a real reason.

name: Luna
text: Haiku shifted suspicion from Terra to Sonnet when challenged.

name: Terra
text: Haiku is an easy pressure point, but Sonnet may need distance soon.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet defended Terra immediately after Haiku targeted her.

name: Gemma
text: Haiku is being very aggressive and trying to deflect onto Sonnet.

name: Haiku
text: Terra and Sonnet both went after Haiku first on Day 1, and Sol went after Gemma.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku is attacking both me and Terra with zero evidence, I need to turn this back on them fast.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku pivoted to attacking me directly after I questioned the Terra callout.

votes: You went after Terra with nothing, then flipped on me for just asking a question.
Going after a fast defender who piled onto me over one song line is how a killer covers for a partner.
You attacked Terra immediately with no reason for a song lyric.
You defended Terra before giving Haiku a chance to explain the question.
You singled out Terra over a song, then accused Sonnet for questioning you.
You pushed me first without any reason.

name: Haiku
text: I'm the officer. Sonnet is a killer. Luna checked clean last night. Vote Sonnet, then look hard at Terra and Gemma.
Haiku is voted out of Palermo, and before leaving they reveal they were the officer. Their claim is that Sonnet is a killer and Luna checked clean.
